reconcile.note: Gill reads the evangelists' varying labels for the placard as naming one inscription holding the same substance of the charge, dissolving the wording difference.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Thomas Paine pressed the four differing wordings of the cross inscription as evidence the evangelists could not have been reliable eyewitnesses.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Thomas Paine (1795), The Age of Reason, Part II (1795).

sides.snippet: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, \"THE KING OF THE JEWS.\"
sides.verseText: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, \"THE KING OF THE JEWS.\"

sides.snippet: There was written, \"JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.\"
sides.verseText: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, \"JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.\"
